rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=15, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-9 DC-STRENGTH (n_cg up) at near-prior-off init_t, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t->0 asymptote pinned: init_t0.02->PSNR33.7, 0.05->28.9... 0.005->35.19dB/RMSE5.94e-3 (iter-8), converging to JUST UNDER baseline 36.32dB/RMSE5.21e-3. hr=0 throughout; the CG-DC-projected near-FBP is marginally WORSE than the plain Hann FBP. (2) FAILURE MODE: at n_cg=5 the CG least-squares solve of min||Ax-y||^2 on the 128-view system is UNDER-converged, leaving residual streaks -> RMSE just above the plain FBP. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_n_cg 5 -> 15 (stronger LSQ CG solve), init_t=0.005 fixed. (4) HYPOTHESIS: more CG iters drive the recon closer to the exact 128-view least-squares solution; IF that LSQ solution beats the plain Hann FBP, hr crosses 0. FALSIFIER: if RMSE stays >=baseline even at n_cg=15, the CG-DC/wavelet recon is genuinely FBP-bounded on sparse breast (the plain regularized-FBP baseline is at/above the unregularized LSQ solution) -> the wavelet prior + DC cannot clear it; conclude. (5) BUDGET: n_cg=15 ~2-3x CG cost, still well inside 20min at ~90s base. (6) iter-10 on landing.
